title: PEAK: Cost-Adaptive Profiling in a Heartbeat
problem: Static instrumentation profiling imposes fixed overhead that cannot adapt to dynamic workload characteristics
motivation: HPC and cloud applications have dynamic workloads requiring adaptive profiling; static approaches create bottlenecks in monitoring long-running applications
method: PEAK uses Dynamic Binary Instrumentation—inserting measurement code into a running program—to profile its performance. Static mode caps overhead at a fixed amount. Heartbeat mode dynamically adjusts how much measuring happens using regular timing pulses, maintaining the user-specified overhead ratio in real-time.
key_novelty: The core novelty is heartbeat-based dynamic adjustment that maintains a constant overhead ratio in real-time, enabling better profiling accuracy for changing workloads.
contributions: Improved profile accuracy for dynamic workloads
limitations: Evaluation limited to specific workload types
